title: Isolate useLayoutEffect errors to the throwing component
body:
When a layout effect or its cleanup throws, the `options._commit` catch clears the render callbacks of every component in the commit queue. Unrelated components that are still mounted lose their layout effects and their `componentDidMount`/`componentDidUpdate`/`setState` callbacks. A second error in the same commit is never reported.

This change replaces the queue of only the component that threw, with one callback that rethrows the error. `commitRoot` then sends the error to that component's boundary through its usual per-component catch, after every other layout effect has run. That still covers what #2193 needed: core never invokes the thrower's leftover hook states.

> This PR was authored by Opus 5.5.
